email.subject: AI for The Law Offices of Leon R. Kowalski & Associates - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Leon,

Your background managing a staff counsel office for a major insurance company in New York City gives you insight into what most trial attorneys never see: how to run lean operations without sacrificing quality. That's exactly the gap we solve.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping practices in General Liability and Labor Law compete at scale.

Worth 20 minutes to explore this?

Vasu
Lucio
